description_en: Modifies the callback URL of an account
description_zh: 修改账号回调地址信息
kebab_example: aliyun cams update-account-webhook --cust-space-id 29348393884940000 --status-callback-url http://www.aliyun.com --http-flag Y --queue-flag N --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateAccountWebhook

parameters.description_en: The space ID of the ISV sub-customer.
parameters.help_en: The space ID of the ISV sub-customer
parameters.name: cust_space_id

parameters.description_en: The callback URL to which status reports are sent by using HTTP callbacks.
parameters.help_en: The callback URL to which status reports are sent by using HTTP callbacks
parameters.name: status_callback_url

parameters.description_en:
Specifies whether to use HTTP callbacks to receive message receipts. Valid values:

- Y: indicates that HTTP callbacks are used to receive receipts.

- N: indicates that HTTP callbacks are not used to receive receipts.
parameters.description_zh:
是否使用HTTP方式接收回执。取值：
- Y：是
- N：否

parameters.description_en:
Specifies whether to use Message Service (MNS) queues to receive receipts. Valid values:

- Y: indicates that MNS queues are used to receive receipts.

- N: indicates that MNS queues are not used to receive receipts.
